events.summary: Both H1 and H2 are well-supported and correctly fixed at the root cause: tax now uses Decimal(ROUND_HALF_UP) as subtotal*rate then total=subtotal+tax, and pagination uses (page-1)*size. All 5 tests now pass. Would not merge as-is without fixing empty-invoice regression introduced by sum().

hypotheses.note: Code at 65-69 used float round() plus backwards tax derivation; reproduced 54.12 vs expected 54.13, log confirms, test failure confirms half-up expectation.
offset=page*size with 1-indexed page directly skips first size rows; reproduced [1003,1004] for page=1/size=2 and coverage failure proves off-by-one.

risks: New crash on empty lines: sum([]) returns int 0 which has no quantize() – original returned 0/0/0. Need sum(..., start=Decimal('0')) or handle empty.
Return casts to float re-exposes binary float representation; API previously returned floats so tests pass but ideal is to keep Decimal/string for money.
Decimal(str(TAX_RATE)) depends on float str() being exact '0.0825'; fragile if TAX_RATE changes – prefer Decimal('0.0825') literal.
